title: Enforce portable storage coverage before shared backend merge
description: Given the shared portable storage adapter and its 100 percent repository coverage requirement, when local and CI quality checks run, then storage source is measured explicitly and meaningful behavioral cases cover missing branches without lowering thresholds or silently excluding production code. Given the reviewed S3/DynamoDB canonical storage contract, when the adapter is consumed from a merged revision, then documented backend composition preserves ordinary files, scopes, conflicts and repair semantics.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Added offline official AWS SDK protocol tests, authorization/query boundary tests, poisoned-catalog and interrupted journal recovery tests, plus unreadable/corrupt filesystem metadata cases. All focused tests pass. Latest complete measurement before final filesystem additions: 96.35 percent lines with AWS enabled; adapter 99.19 percent. New mandatory check-store-coverage target requires 100 percent with all features and currently fails. No existing threshold lowered or production source excluded. Product changes remain local pending required gates; PR33 is not merged.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Coverage completion: the standard repository Tarpaulin gate now passes with all storage features: 100.00 percent, 1163/1163 production source lines, all seven store modules including AWS. 50 native tests and 4 behavior scenarios/14 steps pass; explicit real AWS fixtures remain ignored in routine checks. Added deterministic lock failure, read-growth, catalog race and cross-kind replay regressions. The full make check is actively running after cycling only this task compiler cache to bound disk usage. No threshold lowered or production store file excluded; PR33 remains unmerged until full checks and hosted CI pass.
